blocks.title: Feedback mechanism
blocks.text: A feedback mechanism is one in which a controlling mechanism is itself controlled by the product of the process it controls. The endocrine system is regulated by feedback mechanisms of two kinds, positive and negative.

blocks.prompt: What are the two kinds of feedback in the endocrine system?
blocks.explanation: Positive feedback, which speeds up the process, and negative feedback, which stops it.

items: Feedback: the product controls the process that made it; positive or negative.
